properties.displayName: [AZ-09] Audit VMs using managed disks without a disk encryption set
properties.description: Audits Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines whose OS managed disk lacks a disk encryption set id — the null-check on diskEncryptionSet.id is reproduced against fixtures by run.py (azure/arg/AZ-09.kql). Known false positive: dev/test VMs where platform default encryption suffices (non-production scope).
